sn12.25:12.1: By oneself one instigates the verbal choice, conditioned by which that pleasure and pain arise in oneself.
sn12.25:12.2: Or else others instigate the verbal choice, conditioned by which that pleasure and pain arise in oneself.
sn12.25:12.4: Or else one instigates the verbal choice, conditioned by which that pleasure and pain arise in oneself.
